discrepancy_trace.mechanism_from_source: Two producers. Board verb/priority baked in us_stocks.html from nightly prophet rank (build_site dashboard.html.j2 + _prophet_card). Detail verb/size computed in stock.html.j2 from stockdata/ONTO.json cycle ladder (DISP/ladderAction); comment says cycle caps the verdict and board rank is context. Trigger chip on the card even warns: if card says Wait do not chase — implying verb and trigger can disagree; here the card verb is Buy while detail action is Wait.
